question.text: A carbonyl compound of formula <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>9</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> , which is a benzene derivative gives orange precipitate with 2,4 ‐D.N.P. and also gives yellow precipitate with <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> in presence of aqueous <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mo>.</mo></math> The total no. of isomers possible for ‘A’ are_____

solution.text: Since A is reacting with the 2,4-DNP and showing iodoform reaction, it must be an aromatic methyl ketone.
